We are looking for an experienced and hands-on executive to lead our global Research & Development and Technology organization. In this role, you will combine the operational leadership of a large, globally distributed R&D organization with the strategic responsibility for the technology roadmap of Siemens Electrical Products. You will work regularly at our key development and product locations, with a strong presence in Amberg, Germany, where a significant part of the organization is based. International travel and the flexibility to spend extended periods at global sites are essential.

- An advanced academic degree or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering or a closely related technical field. Candidates with a background in physics may also be considered if they bring extensive professional experience in the electrical or electrification industry. A doctorate is an advantage.   - Extensive professional experience, including significant executive leadership responsibility within large, globally distributed R&D and Engineering organizations spanning multiple development centers and cultures - Deep technical and product experience in electrical engineering, electrification, electromechanical systems, or comparable industrial products, combined with a sound understanding of power electronics, electronics, embedded software, connectivity, and system architecture.   - The ability to combine strategic technology leadership with hands-on operational R&D management and to engage credibly in detailed discussions about products, systems, architectures, and engineering trade-offs.   - A strong track record in transforming R&D organizations, technology portfolios, platforms, architectures, and global engineering capabilities, translated into successful products and measurable business results.   - Experience in managing technology and product portfolios, leading global R&D organizations, overseeing significant innovation investments, and driving strategic make, partner, or buy decisions. - Strong critical thinking and business sense, with the ability to set clear priorities, make evidence-based technology and investment decisions, and discontinue activities that do not support the strategic direction.   - The ability to navigate a complex global matrix, establish clear decision rights, resolve conflicts constructively, and collaborate closely with business leaders, Product Management, manufacturing, quality, and other multi-functional partners.   - Excellent executive communication and partner management skills, combined with the ability to develop senior leaders, technical experts, and successors in a global organization.   - An international approach, fluency in English, and proven experience in leading across countries and cultures. At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.
